subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay bounded media from unmentioned group messages for later mentioned turns, and what limits should apply to media kind, TTL, local-path exposure, and group/context visibility?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the repair changes how bystander group attachments can enter later model context, so automation should not choose that privacy/security boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded local image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep text-only unmentioned history
options.body: Preserve the safer current behavior and document that unmentioned Telegram media is not replayed unless it is part of the current or visible reply turn.

options.title: Require Live Design Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue open until a Telegram live proof demonstrates the failure and proposed retention behavior before approving implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded local image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the shared recent-history media pipeline and is the strongest available routing candidate for the security/product boundary decision.
